runs.text:
Over the course of three decades, Rammstein have shaped heavy music with their unique blend of industrial sound, provocative aesthetics, and spectacular live shows. 

Formed in Berlin in 1994, the line-up has remained unchanged: Till Lindemann, Richard Z. Kruspe, Paul Landers, Oliver Riedel, Christoph Schneider, and Flake Lorenz. 

Their debut “Herzeleid" (1995) laid the foundation for an international career that brought worldwide hits like “Du Hast”, “Sonne”, and “Mein Teil.” 

Eight studio albums, including two German No.1 singles (“Pussy”, “Deutschland") and their most recent release “Zeit" (2022), have earned them multiple gold and platinum awards worldwide as well as Grammy nominations. 

Known for uncompromising creativity, iconic videos, and incendiary stage productions, Rammstein continue to defy convention and sell out stadiums across the globe – writing one of the most influential and unique chapters in rock history.
